limitations: packages/compare/{normalization,alignment} are contract-delivered paths outside the scaffold's src/ include; wiring package exports and the shared node entry point is the comparison-runtime task's scope. Type-cleanliness of the new modules was verified with an equivalent noEmit/allowImportingTsExtensions config: zero diagnostics in the new files.

Occurrence inputs in TEST-12 are synthetic constructions per F11-F15 dimension descriptions; no reader-produced PDF extractions were fabricated. Reader integration evidence belongs to downstream comparison tasks.
Exchange margins consider local exchanges conflicting with at most two other chosen pairs; deeper crossing chains are covered by the non-crossing re-solve term of the same margin.

Digits/currency/sign/negation/combining.detail: normalization.test.mjs asserts scalar-exact preservation of '1,000'/'1000'/'100'/'-100'/'−100'/'+42.0'/'$1,000.50'/'€9.99'/'(100)'/'paid'/'not paid' (all stay distinct values), combining mark U+0301 survival as a separate scalar, ligature U+FB01/U+FB03 non-expansion, no casefold, and material-scalar classification (Nd/Sc/Sm/Pd). alignment.test.mjs asserts material substitution cost ('0'->'O' = 2 per scalar, distance 2/len vs plain 1/len) and negation distance 0.5 ('not paid' vs 'paid').

four repeated equal values remain four o.detail: F11: four identical '100' occurrences per side at distinct positions produce res.left.length === 4 and res.right.length === 4, all 'unique', with four distinct one_to_one matches covering l0..l3 x r0..r3 — never a shared first match. The 4-vs-3 variant leaves the unpaired left 'unmatched' rather than absorbing it.

ambiguous ties abstain.detail: Five identical 'x' occurrences at identical geometry: res.matches.length === 0, every ambiguous entry has reason 'tie' with margin 0.1 < 0.12 and >=2 accessible candidates; all ten occurrences are 'ambiguous'. Weak agreements (cost > 0.45) and ordinal inversions (order_conflict) abstain the same way — verified by the 'weak' and 'order_conflict' cases in the suite.

page-only inputs never become exact regi.detail: page_only and unknown precision occurrences with text identical to an exact-geometry right-side reading stay 'page_level', the right side stays 'unmatched', res.page_level lists both ids, and no match is produced — identical text cannot rescue missing geometry. A zero-area polygon is likewise 'page_level' (diagnostics.degenerate_geometry counts it); the real regional pair in the same page still matches 'unique'.

no unbounded quadratic matching..detail: A 70-fragment linked component on each side abstains entirely: reason 'component_too_large', fragment_counts [70,70], every occurrence 'abstained', blocks_abstained 1 — no global search runs. For 20 isolated pairs the diagnostics expose bounded counters: span_gate_checks <= span-pairs/4 (local windows only) and assignment_cells <= 65*65*assignments_solved (every solve on a <=64-fragment component grid).
